name: Golduck
description: The forelegs are webbed, helping to make it an adept swimmer. It can be seen swimming elegantly in lakes, etc.

moves.name: Scratch
moves.description: Hard, pointed, and sharp claws rake the foe.

moves.name: Tail Whip
moves.description: The user wags its tail cutely, making the foe lower its DEFENSE stat.

moves.name: Disable
moves.description: For a few turns, it prevents the foe from using the move it last used.

moves.name: Water Sport
moves.description: Weakens FIRE-type attacks while the user is in the battle.

moves.name: Confusion
moves.description: A weak telekinetic attack that may also leave the foe confused.

moves.name: Screech
moves.description: An ear-splitting screech is emitted to sharply reduce the foe’s DEFENSE.

moves.name: Psych Up
moves.description: The user hypnotizes itself into copying any stat change made by the foe.

moves.name: Fury Swipes
moves.description: The foe is raked with sharp claws or scythes two to five times.

moves.name: Hydro Pump
moves.description: A high volume of water is blasted at the foe under great pressure.

moves.name: Surf
moves.description: A big wave crashes down on the foe. Can also be used for crossing water.

moves.name: Ice Beam
moves.description: The foe is struck with an icy beam. It may freeze the foe solid.

moves.name: Blizzard
moves.description: The foe is blasted with a blizzard. It may freeze the foe solid.

moves.name: Hyper Beam
moves.description: A severely damaging attack that makes the user rest on the next turn.

moves.name: Strength
moves.description: The foe is slugged at maximum power. Can also be used to move boulders.

moves.name: Dig
moves.description: An attack that hits on the 2nd turn. Can also be used to exit dungeons.

moves.name: Toxic
moves.description: A move that badly poisons the foe. Its poison damage worsens every turn.

moves.name: Double Team
moves.description: The user creates illusory copies of itself to raise its evasiveness.

moves.name: Waterfall
moves.description: A powerful charge attack. It can also be used to climb a waterfall.

moves.name: Flash
moves.description: A blast of light that cuts the foe’s accuracy. It also illuminates caves.

moves.name: Rest
moves.description: The user sleeps for two turns to fully restore HP and heal any status problem.

moves.name: Protect
moves.description: Enables the user to evade all attacks. It may fail if used in succession.

moves.name: Attract
moves.description: If it is the other gender, the foe is made infatuated and unlikely to attack.

moves.name: Return
moves.description: This attack move grows more powerful the more the user likes its TRAINER.

moves.name: Frustration
moves.description: This attack move grows more powerful the less the user likes its TRAINER.

moves.name: Iron Tail
moves.description: An attack with a steel-hard tail. It may lower the foe’s DEFENSE stat.

moves.name: Hidden Power
moves.description: An attack that varies in type and intensity depending on the user.

moves.name: Rain Dance
moves.description: A heavy rain falls for five turns, powering up WATER- type moves.

moves.name: Rock Smash
moves.description: An attack that may also cut DEFENSE. It can also smash cracked boulders.

moves.name: Hail
moves.description: A hailstorm lasting five turns damages all POKéMON except the ICE-type.

moves.name: Facade
moves.description: An attack that is boosted if user is burned, poisoned, or paralyzed.

moves.name: Focus Punch
moves.description: An attack that is executed last. The user flinches if hit beforehand.

moves.name: Brick Break
moves.description: An attack that also breaks any barrier like LIGHT SCREEN and REFLECT.

moves.name: Secret Power
moves.description: An attack that may have an additional effect that varies with the terrain.

moves.name: Dive
moves.description: The user dives underwater on the first turn and strikes next turn.

moves.name: Aerial Ace
moves.description: An extremely fast attack against one target. It can’t be evaded.

moves.name: Calm Mind
moves.description: The user focuses its mind to raise the SP. ATK and SP. DEF stats.

moves.name: Water Pulse
moves.description: An attack with a pulsing blast of water. It may also confuse the foe.

moves.name: Mega Punch
moves.description: The foe is slugged by a punch thrown with muscle-packed power.

moves.name: Mega Kick
moves.description: The foe is attacked by a kick fired with muscle-packed power.

moves.name: Body Slam
moves.description: The user drops its full body on the foe. It may leave the foe paralyzed.

moves.name: Double-Edge
moves.description: A reckless, life- risking tackle that also hurts the user a little.

moves.name: Counter
moves.description: A retaliation move that counters any physical hit with double the damage.

moves.name: Seismic Toss
moves.description: A gravity-fed throw that causes damage matching the user’s level.

moves.name: Mimic
moves.description: The user copies the move last used by the foe for the rest of the battle.

moves.name: Substitute
moves.description: The user creates a decoy using one- quarter of its full HP.
